title: Per-group send numbers on the Send tab belong to the open campaign only
steps: Run the send ledger suite against a private PostgreSQL (TEST_DATABASE_URL) from this branch.
expect: GET /sending?campaign=<id> answers groups counted for that campaign only.
Without ?campaign, and for another campaign, groups is empty.
evidence: On dev on 22/10/2026 the JomSocial win-back Send tab showed 'A: expired 2025 to now: 301 sent' while that campaign had sent none: the numbers were the Tracy campaign's group_1.
fence: Private test database only; no mailbox, no customer address.

tests: estimated clicks: with the switch on
